[[File:T3-ST.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The droid F-29 converses with [[Lady Droid|another droid]] via Star*Link]]
'''Star*Link''' was a video transmission device designed for communication between two individuals. The device was found in public areas.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref>

The [[Tomorrowland Starport]] had a Star*Link booth. In the months following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the homesick repair [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[F-29-PSKx]] used the Starlink often to call his [[Lady Droid|girlfriend]].<ref name="CGST">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>
